name: How much does it cost to build a tiny home for rental in San Marcos?

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build a tiny home for rental in San Marcos?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost to build a tiny home for rental in San Marcos varies significantly based on factors such as size, materials, finishes, and necessary site preparations. A basic unit might start around $80,000, while a custom-designed, higher-end model with premium features could exceed $150,000. These figures generally include construction but exclude land, utility connections, permits, and specific site development costs which can add substantially to the overall investment. Consulting with a local builder can provide a more precise estimate.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a rental tiny home in San Marcos can range from $80,000 to over $150,000, depending on size, materials, and finishes, excluding land and site development.
